006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.AbstractCodedMetapathException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * FOCA: Exceptions related to type casting.
015 */
016public class CastFunctionException
017    extends AbstractCodedMetapathException {
018  /**
019   * <a href=
020   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOCA0002">err:FOCA0002</a>:
021   * Raised by fn:resolve-QName and fn:QName when a supplied value does not have
022   * the lexical form of a QName or URI respectively; and when casting to decimal,
023   * if the supplied value is NaN or Infinity.
024   */
025  public static final int INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE = 2;
026
027  /**
028   * <a href=
029   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOCA0003">err:FOCA0003</a>:
030   * Raised when casting to xs:integer if the supplied value exceeds the
031   * implementation-defined limits for the datatype.
032   */
033  public static final int INPUT_VALUE_TOO_LARGE = 3;
034
035  /**
036   * the serial version UUID.
037   */
038  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
039
040  @NonNull
041  private final IAnyAtomicItem item;
042
043  /**
044   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
045   * no cause.
046   *
047   * @param code
048   *          the error code value
049   * @param item
050   *          the item the exception applies to
051   * @param message
052   *          the exception message text
053   */
054  public CastFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item, String message) {
055    super(code, message);
056    this.item = item;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code item}, and
061   * {@code cause}.
062   *
063   * @param code
064   *          the error code value
065   * @param item
066   *          the item the exception applies to
067   * @param message
068   *          the exception message text
069   * @param cause
070   *          the original exception cause
071   */
072  public CastFunctionException(int code, @NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item, String message, Throwable cause) {
073    super(code, message, cause);
074    this.item = item;
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Get the item associated with the exception.
079   *
080   * @return the associated item
081   */
082  @NonNull
083  public IAnyAtomicItem getItem() {
084    return item;
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public String getCodePrefix() {
089    return "FOCA";
090  }
091}
